def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells); maxr = max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y,x in cells); maxc = max(x for y,x in cells)
            mask = [(y-minr, x-minc) for y,x in cells]
            objects.append((minc, color, maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1, mask))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for i, (_, color, oh, ow, mask) in enumerate(objects):
        for dr, dc in mask:
            if 0 <= r0+dr < h and 0 <= c0+dc < w:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color
        r0 += oh - 1
        c0 += ow - 1
    return out
